item.title: Community calendar, Aug. 6-13
item.description: Thursday - Daily AA meetings – Visit AASalidaBVLeadville.com for information on daily Zoom meetings at several different times, some with passwords. 24-hour hotline: 888-333-9649. Some small group meetings are also reopening. Check website for details.

item.title: Council approves $388,102 contract for pool repairs
item.description: Salida City Council unanimously approved everything on the agenda, which wasn’t much, at the Aug. 4 regular meeting.
item.dc:creator: Cailey McDermott, Managing Editor

item.title: County terminates SWAT agreement
item.description: Chaffee County commissioners voted unanimously at their Aug. 4 meeting to terminate participation in a regional Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) Intergovernmental Agreement (IGA) with the cities of Salida and Buena Vista.
item.dc:creator: Joshua Pike, OMG Reporter

item.title: 2026 4-H Junior Market Livestock Sale raises $317,925
item.description: The 2026 Chaffee County 4-H Junior Market Livestock Sale raised $317,925 July 31 at Chaffee County Fairgrounds. The 1,483-pound Grand Champion beef, raised by Lane Brandt, sold for $15,000 to Larry Sherwood with Lowry Construction.
item.dc:creator: Cailey McDermott, Managing Editor

item.title: Bicycle tour to visit Chaffee County Aug. 10-12
item.description: Approximately 300 cyclists will participate in a week-long bicycle tour beginning Aug. 10 on highways and several county roads in the Crested Butte, Buena Vista, Salida and Gunnison areas.

item.title: County talks wildfire prevention, outages with Xcel Energy
item.description: Chaffee County commissioners discussed wildfire mitigation work and the importance of reducing power outages with representatives from Xcel Energy during their Aug. 4 meeting.
item.dc:creator: Joshua Pike, OMG Reporter

item.title: Event Calendar, Aug. 6-13
item.description: Thurs., Aug. 6 - Buena Vista - 9 a.m.-6 p.m. – Buena Vista Contin-Tail Gem, Mineral & Fossil Show at BV Rodeo Grounds on Gregg Drive features about 100 vendors showcasing gems, minerals, fossils, lapidary art, handmade jewelry and more,…

item.title: Habitat raises $30,000 at annual fundraiser
item.description: Chaffee County Habitat for Humanity’s 12th annual Mac & Cheese Bake-Off raised about $30,000 July 23 at the Mount Princeton Hot Springs Resort Pavilion.

item.title: Commissioners hears update on new evacuation tool
item.description: At an Aug. 3 work session of the Chaffee County Board of County Commissioners, Chaffee County Emergency Manager William Plackner provided an update on new evacuation maps the county plans to implement to improve resident notifications and other emergency activities.
item.dc:creator: Joshua Pike, OMG Reporter

item.title: Outwest Investment plans to keep Mountain Timbers Storage focused on locals
item.description: Mountain Timbers Storage, a self-storage facility at 11190 U.S. 50 in Poncha Springs, was recently bought by Outwest Investment with plans for expanding opportunities for local businesses.
item.dc:creator: Lijah Sampson, Mail Reporter

item.title: Green Drinks Salida to host two events in August
item.description: Sustainable Chaffee invites community members to attend one of two Green Drinks events in August to learn about Colorado's upcoming Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) program and what it means for recycling in Chaffee County.

item.title: Accidental Angler: Stillwater blues
item.description: I rowed the pontoon boat to shore then walked the short distance to my camp. Retrieving my water bottle from the cooler, I drank deeply, letting some of the water run out the sides of my mouth, down my neck…
item.dc:creator: Hayden Mellsop, Special to The Mail

item.title: ‘Jazz Musicians Wanted’: Monthly event brings jazz musicians together
item.description: “Jazz Musicians Wanted,” a locally organized group of musicians, has had six monthly jam sessions at Salida SteamPlant with jazz lovers coming from near and far to find their people and play music with a group.
item.dc:creator: Lijah Sampson, Mail Reporter

item.title: Funeral notice: Dean Roberts
item.description: Memorial services for longtime and well-known Salidan Dean Roberts will be held at 1:30 p.m. Aug. 8, 2026, at Temple Baptist Church in Salida.

item.title: CMC offers free copies of ‘Go as a River’ ahead of author visit
item.description: Colorado Mountain College selected “Go as a River” by Shelley Read as its 2026 Common Reader, and Read, a fifth-generation Coloradan, will visit both Salida and Leadville campuses in October.

item.title: AVHS: This ’n’ that and books for summer reading
item.description: I recently received a publication called This Week in the mail and found this fascinating article about dogs being left-pawed. About one in 10 people are left-handed, but according to a new study, the percentage is much higher in dogs.…
item.dc:creator: Judy Lore, AVHS Columnist

item.title: Obituary: Mary Jo Bernard
item.description: Mary Jo Bernard, beloved mother, grandmother, sister, aunt and friend, passed away on July 6, 2026, with her son Pete and daughter, Susie, by her side. She was 82 years old.

item.title: State serves Butala cease and desist
item.description: Butala Sand & Gravel has been closed since July 7, following state and federal orders after the company reportedly moved and possibly sold contaminated materials.
item.dc:creator: Cailey McDermott, Managing Editor

item.title: A partnership of equals: Salida Vineyard welcomes co-pastors
item.description: Salida Vineyard Church has officially entered a new season. As of June 28, Ellen Horarik and Scott Sailors have stepped into the roles of senior co-pastors, effectively ending a two-year period of discernment and transition for the congregation.
item.dc:creator: Cailey McDermott, Managing Editor

item.title: Hospital board hears overview of EPIC platform

item.dc:creator: Jack Sellner, Mail Reporter
